story.fullStory:
Shakira's "Objection Tango" reached #55 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Objection (Tango)" is a song by Colombian singer-songwriter Shakira for her fifth studio album and first English-language album Laundry Service (2001).

The song peaked at #55 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Objection Tango was released in 2001.

"Objection (Tango)" is a song by Colombian singer-songwriter Shakira for her fifth studio album and first English-language album Laundry Service (2001).
It was the first song Shakira wrote in English after being encouraged by American singer Gloria Estefan to record material in the language.
"Objection (Tango)" musically combines elements of pop rock and tango, and contains instrumentation from the bandoneón and guitar.
Laundry Service (Spanish: Servicio de lavandería) is the fifth studio album and first English-language album by Colombian singer-songwriter Shakira.
It was released on 5 November 2001, by Epic Records.
After her fourth studio album Dónde Están los Ladrones?
